decision: Routed the request to figure-it-out and opened a worktree on feat/pi-cursor-cli from origin/main
why: The request spans every Cursor TUI surface, so it is too large for the Feature playbook; a worktree keeps the dirty main checkout untouched

decision: Grounded on the four research reports, the captures, Pi 0.87.1 docs, extensions/types.d.ts, pi-tui exports and the checked examples
why: The design has to rest on what Pi documents and what the research actually says
evidence: research README.md, source-*.md; docs/extensions.md, tui.md, themes.md, keybindings.md, packages.md; dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts

decision: Found that Pi built-in slash commands run before extension commands with the same name
why: interactive-mode onSubmit matches /model /resume /fork /compact /copy /name /new /quit /logout /settings /debug before any extension dispatch, and autocomplete filters duplicate names

decision: Found that registerShortcut cannot take reserved app keys such as shift+tab, ctrl+l, ctrl+o, ctrl+t, ctrl+g
why: The runner skips extension shortcuts that collide with reserved keybindings, so mode cycling on shift+tab has to live in the CustomEditor, which the docs say owns the keys it handles

decision: Found that the theme schema rejects custom color names
why: colors has additionalProperties false, so Cursor-only tokens such as the decision purple and debug pink need a code palette keyed by the active theme

decision: Created extensions/pi-cursor-cli with themes, palette, constants, format; npm install + typecheck + tests + c8 gates green
why: Theme JSONs must validate against pi's 56-role schema (additionalProperties false); Cursor-only tokens live in code keyed by theme name
result: typecheck green; 43 tests pass; lines 98.88% branches 90.27%; schema check: 0 extra 0 missing required

decision: Header, footer, working indicator via setHeader/setFooter/setWorkingIndicator with real Theme instances in tests
why: Cursor hex tokens cannot enter theme.fg (fixed role union); palette emits truecolor/ANSI256 directly, named colors use basic SGR (magenta 35)
result: typecheck green; 37 tests pass; lines 97.61% branches 89.13%

decision: Registered Cursor-style renderers for pi's seven built-in tools, delegating execute to create*Tool originals; stateful call rows flip verb on result via shared row state
why: pi's renderCall renders once, so past-tense verbs use the official ToolRenderContext.state pattern (pi's own EditRenderState approach); bash exit code parsed from output like pi's own example

decision: TodosUI as todo_update tool with details-based branch-safe state; DecisionSurface gate on tool_call for bash/edit/write with allowlist and run-everything bypass; non-TUI modes proceed without approval
why: pi blocks tools via tool_call {block, reason}; decisions render through ctx.ui.custom; reserved-key limits do not apply inside custom components
result: typecheck green; 60 tests pass; lines 95.09% branches 88.17%

decision: CursorEditor extends CustomEditor: shift+tab mode cycle, vim insert/normal with hjkl mapping, half-block composer frame, empty-state placeholder with inverse first character
why: setEditorComponent is the official editor replacement; shift+tab must live in the editor because runner.js reserves shortcut keys; super.render stays in charge once text exists
result: typecheck green; 67 tests pass; lines 95.64% branches 89.58%

decision: Delegated command registry (64 entries with verbatim Cursor ids/aliases/descriptions, mapped/unmet statuses with reasons) and pagers (context segmented bar, usage totals, copy-message picker); resolved conflicts: copy/usage/context register via pagers module with registeredBy flag, rewind maps to pi /tree (worker's pi-/rewind claim was wrong)
why: One data table owns command parity; pagers own the three interactive surfaces; registry entries marked registeredBy skip registerCommands

decision: Notifications via agent_settled with per-terminal OSC escapes, DCS tmux passthrough, focus gating; /rule wizard retargeted from .cursor/rules to AGENTS.md with Cursor result states
why: pi's rule mechanism is AGENTS.md; Cursor writes .cursor/rules/*.mdc — the file target adapts, the wizard flow and messages stay Cursor-exact
result: typecheck green; 102 tests pass; lines 93.9% branches 89.7%

decision: check-docs.mjs: every named import from pi packages must exist in installed declarations; dist/ deep imports rejected; negative control flagged NoSuchMember and restored
why: Named-import conformance against installed 0.87.1 declarations is the enforceable form of documentation adherence
result: baseline exit 0; negative control exit 1 naming the member; restored exit 0

decision: 362-row parity matrix with check-parity gate and negative controls (deleted row, fake id, broken evidence path all caught)
why: Matrix statuses from real coverage: implemented 94, mapped 104, deviation 33, unmet 131; registry divergence on 7 ids resolved toward mapped
result: gate exit 0; negative control exit 1 naming the missing row

decision: Real-pi tmux smoke with scripted provider (smoke/scripted): 9/9 assertions PASS including approval flow, todo rows, shift+tab headline
why: Gate caught two real defects: pi seeds renderer state as {} so ??= seeds never applied (bash verb rendered "undefined"), and unconditional invalidate() in renderResult looped renders at ~300/s duplicating rows

decision: Copy pager registration dropped for pi builtin /copy (conflict warning in capture); registry copy mapped to pi
why: Built-in commands resolve before extension commands; the capture made the conflict visible
result: smoke exit 0 with no conflict warning

decision: README, parity.md, Makefile verify wiring (verify-cursor-cli target); deslop removed internal-only exports and dead helpers
why: Root make verify is the repo gate; docs state the implemented/mapped/deviation/unmet classification per framing P1
